post.description:
### POST /api/users/signup

This endpoint is used to sign up a new user.

#### Request Body

- `name` (text): The name of the user.
    
- `email` (text): The email address of the user.
    
- `mobile_number` (text): The mobile number of the user.
    
- `role` (text): The role of the user.
    
- `city` (text): The city of the user.
    
- `state` (text): The state of the user.
    
- `address` (text): The address of the user.
    
- `password` (text): The password for the user account.
    
- `aadhar_number` (text): The Aadhar number of the user.
    
- `otp` (text): The one-time password for verification.
    
- `aadhar_file` (file): A file containing the user's Aadhar card.
    

#### Response (201 - application/json)

``` json
{
    "message": "",
    "status": true
}

 ```

The response schema:

- `message` (string): A message from the server.
    
- `status` (boolean): The status of the request.

### Logout User

This endpoint is used to log out a user.

**Request Body**

- No request body is required for this endpoint.
    

**Response**

- Status: 200
    
- Content-Type: application/json
    
- { "message": "", "status": true, "user": {}}
    

Upon successful logout, the response will contain a status message along with the user status.

### Verify Forgot Password OTP

This endpoint is used to verify the OTP (One Time Password) for the forgot password process.

#### Request Body Parameters

- `email` (text): The email address of the user requesting the OTP verification.
    
- `otp` (text): The OTP received by the user for verification.
    

#### Response

Upon successful verification, the API returns a JSON object with the following fields:

- `message`: A message indicating the result of the OTP verification.
    
- `status`: A boolean value indicating the status of the OTP verification process.
    

Example:

``` json
{
    "message": "",
    "status": true
}

 ```

post.description:
This API endpoint is a POST request used to send an OTP for user login via mobile number. The request should include a JSON payload with the user's mobile number and role.

### Request Body

- `mobile_number` (string) - The mobile number of the user.
    
- `role` (string) - The role of the user.
    

### Response

Upon successful execution, the API returns a JSON response with the following fields:

- `message` (string) - A message related to the response.
    
- `status` (boolean) - Indicates the status of the operation.
    
- `otp` (string) - The One-Time Password (OTP) sent to the user for login.
    

The response status code is 200, and the content type is `application/json`.

### Login with OTP

This endpoint allows users to log in using a one-time password (OTP).

#### Request Body

- `mobile_number` (text): The mobile number of the user.
    
- `otp` (text): The one-time password received by the user.
    

#### Response

- `message` (string): A message related to the login status.
    
- `status` (boolean): Indicates the status of the login attempt.
    
- `user` (object): Contains user information including ID, name, email, mobile, role, OTP, expiration time, verification status, city, state, address, Aadhar number, and Aadhar file.

### GET /api/users/userdetails/{userId}

This endpoint retrieves the details of a specific user.

#### Request

No request body is required for this endpoint.

- Path Parameters
    
    - `userId` (number) - The unique identifier of the user.
        

#### Response

The response will be a JSON object with the following properties:

- `message` (string) - A message related to the response.
    
- `status` (boolean) - The status of the response.
    
- `user` (object) - An object containing the details of the user.
    
    - `id` (number) - The unique identifier of the user.
        
    - `name` (string) - The name of the user.
        
    - `email` (string) - The email address of the user.
        
    - `password` (string) - The password of the user.
        
    - `mobile` (string) - The mobile number of the user.
        
    - `role` (string) - The role of the user.
        
    - `otp` (number) - The one-time password of the user.
        
    - `expires_at` (string) - The expiration date of the OTP.
        
    - `is_verified` (number) - The verification status of the user.
        
    - `status` (string) - The status of the user.
        
    - `city` (string) - The city of the user.
        
    - `state` (string) - The state of the user.
        
    - `address` (string) - The address of the user.
        
    - `aadhar_number` (string) - The Aadhar number of the user.
        
    - `aadhar_file` (string) - The file path of the Aadhar card.
        

#### JSON Schema

{
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {

### Update User Details

This endpoint is used to update the details of a specific user.

#### Request Body Parameters

- `name` (text): The name of the user.
    
- `email` (text): The email address of the user.
    
- `role` (text): The role of the user.
    
- `password` (text): The password of the user.
    
- `city` (text): The city where the user is located.
    
- `mobile_number` (text): The mobile number of the user.
    
- `whatsapp_number` (text): The WhatsApp number of the user.
    
- `alternate_email` (text): An alternate email address for the user.
    
- `company_name` (text): The name of the company the user is associated with.
    
- `about` (text): A brief description about the user.
    
- `experience` (text): The experience of the user.
    
- `total_project` (text): The total number of projects completed by the user.
    
- `on_going_project` (text): The number of ongoing projects for the user.
    
- `operating_in` (text): The area where the user is operating.
    
- `profile_photo` (file): The profile photo of the user.
    
- `upload_brochure` (file): A brochure uploaded by the user.
    

#### Response

The response will be in JSON format with the following fields:

- `message`: A message indicating the status of the update operation.
    
- `status`: A boolean value indicating the success status of the update operation.

The POST request is used to create a shortlist for a user on the platform. The request should be made to [https://rm-be.perimattic.dev/api/users/shortlistcreate](https://rm-be.perimattic.dev/api/users/shortlistcreate).

### Request Body

The request body should be of type x-www-form-urlencoded and include the following parameters:

- `user_id` (text) - The ID of the user for whom the shortlist is being created.
    
- `submit_listing_id` (text) - The ID of the listing being added to the shortlist.
    

### Response

Upon successful execution, the API returns a status code of 200 and a JSON response with the following structure:

``` json
{
    "message": "",
    "status": true
}

 ```

The `message` field may contain additional information, and the `status` field indicates the success of the operation.

### Contact Create

This endpoint allows users to create a new contact.

#### Request

- Method: POST
    
- URL: `https://rm-be.perimattic.dev/api/users/contactcreate`
    
- Body (x-www-form-urlencoded):
    
    - `name` (text): The name of the contact.
        
    - `email` (text): The email of the contact.
        
    - `phone` (text): The phone number of the contact.
        
    - `submit_listing_id` (text): The ID of the submitted listing.
        
    - `user_id` (text): The ID of the user.
        

#### Response

The response is in JSON format and has the following schema:

``` json
{
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
        "message": {
            "type": "string"
        },
        "status": {
            "type": "boolean"
        }
    }
}

 ```

- `message` (string): A message related to the status of the request.
    
- `status` (boolean): Indicates the status of the request, where `true` means the request was successful.

### Get Agent Details

This endpoint makes an HTTP GET request to retrieve the details of a specific agent by their ID.

#### Request

- Method: GET
    
- URL: `https://rm-be.perimattic.dev/api/users/agentdetails/2`
    

This request does not require a request body.

#### Response

- Status: 200
    
- Content-Type: application/json
    

##### Response Body

The response body contains the following key-value pairs:

- `agent`: An object containing the details of the agent, including their ID, name, email, mobile number, role, and other information. Some fields may be null or empty based on the availability of information.
    
- `status`: A boolean indicating the success status of the request.
    
- `total_properties`: The total number of properties associated with the agent.
    
- `total_residential`: The total number of residential properties associated with the agent.
    
- `total_commercial`: The total number of commercial properties associated with the agent.
    
- `residential`: An array containing details of residential properties associated with the agent, including property title, project title, description, address, and other property-specific information.
    
- `commercial`: An array containing details of commercial properties associated with the agent, including property title, project title, description, address, and other property-specific information.
    

#### Headers
